get.description: Authenticated user only; no owner/issuer/subject parameter or management role is accepted. Includes joined memberships and active applications in configured groups; excludes removed or unmanaged groups. Ordered by group ID in bytewise ascending order. Read-only: no admission, punishment, inbox or audit writes.

deadline.description: UTC timestamp. 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z means no deadline/event is currently set.

reminder.description: UTC timestamp. 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z means no deadline/event is currently set.

last_play.description: UTC timestamp. 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z means no deadline/event is currently set.

muted_until.description: UTC timestamp. 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z means no deadline/event is currently set.

lease_until.description: Execution lease deadline; present only while executing.

attachments.description: Opaque media references. Backend proxy enforces current group access and the same expiry.

number.description: Masked QQ group number; only its final four digits are shown.
Optional real group number for create/update; omitted preserves the stored masked number.

expected_revision.description: 0 creates a group; otherwise must equal the current revision. A successful update increments revision by one.

password.description: Omitted preserves password; empty clears it (not allowed in password mode). Never returned or saved as plaintext.

number.description: Masked QQ group number, same as GroupConfig.number.

member_count.description: Number of members whose joined fact is currently true.

pending_count.description: Sum of unresolved eligibility records (requested, awaiting_verification, grace, extended, removal_pending) and actions in pending/executing/unknown. One member can contribute to both counts.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next scan, or empty when exhausted. A filtered page may be empty with a nonempty cursor.

number.description: Masked group number, showing at most the final four digits; empty when not recorded.

joined.description: True only after the bot confirms group membership; an application does not imply joining.

state.description: Stored processing state for this authenticated user; removed memberships are excluded.

deadline.description: Current deadline in UTC, or null when none. Reads do not extend or restart the deadline.

requires_password.description: The group uses password mode. A previously accepted password is not listed as missing.

eligibility.description: Current prerequisite assessment, separate from recorded membership/approval or exemption. Any required unknown fact prevents eligible.

missing_conditions.description: Confirmed unmet conditions only. restricted discloses no blacklist reasons or management data.

unknown_conditions.description: Required facts whose provider explicitly reported unknown. A provider failure instead returns HTTP 503 with no partial page.

next_actions.description: UI action categories, not authorization grants. Unknown facts suggest refresh. Unsupported stages suggest contacting an administrator rather than repeating verification.

next_cursor.description: Last returned group ID if another page exists, or empty when exhausted.
